title: Crypto's CLARITY Vote Is TODAY | Robinhood Upgrades Tokenized Stocks + Fed Hike Tomorrow
description: The Senate's critical CLARITY Act vote is TODAY, and the fight over crypto market structure, stablecoin rewards and bank power is coming to a head. On W3BC LIVE we're breaking down what the vote actually means, Robinhood's move to add redemptions and voting rights to tokenized stocks, tomorrow's Fed decision under Chair Kevin Warsh, institutional money piling deeper into crypto, and whether AI needs a literal kill switch. Plus NFL Week 2 power rankings, the Kawhi Leonard trade, UFC, boxing and The Trenches. GM. Get Money. 1% Better Every Day.

newsStories.headline: THE BIG STORY · CLARITY ACT VOTE DAY
newsStories.dek: The Senate is expected to vote today on advancing the landmark crypto market-structure bill.
newsStories.body: Today's digest says Senate Republicans released updated bill text with 126 substantive changes requested by Democrats as lawmakers make a final push for enough bipartisan support to advance the CLARITY Act. The legislation would establish federal rules for digital assets and clarify regulatory responsibilities, but the banking industry's fight over stablecoin rewards remains alive.
newsStories.takeaway: TODAY WE FIND OUT WHETHER 'REGULATORY CLARITY' STAYS A CRYPTO SLOGAN OR STARTS BECOMING U.S. LAW.
newsStories.source: Reuters / CNBC / NPR / ABC News via Sep 15 digest

newsStories.headline: BANKS vs CRYPTO · THE STABLECOIN REWARDS FIGHT ISN'T OVER
newsStories.dek: Eight banking groups are pushing for tighter limits as the Senate prepares to vote.
newsStories.body: The digest highlights Reuters and CoinDesk reporting that banking groups remain opposed to parts of the bill involving stablecoin rewards. The fight gets to the heart of whether stablecoins become a serious competitor for deposits and yield-bearing financial products.
points: CLARITY ACT · BIGGER THAN TOKEN CLASSIFICATION
newsStories.takeaway: FOLLOW THE INCENTIVES: THIS ISN'T JUST ABOUT CRYPTO RULES. IT'S ABOUT WHO GETS TO HOLD YOUR MONEY.

newsStories.headline: INSTITUTIONS KEEP MOVING IN · $6.8B INTO CRYPTO ETFs IN SIX WEEKS
newsStories.dek: The institutional-adoption story keeps getting harder to dismiss.
newsStories.body: Today's digest reports crypto ETFs attracted $6.8 billion over six consecutive weeks, including $1.3 billion last week, with BlackRock's IBIT capturing $3.4 billion. Cantor Fitzgerald also called Robinhood particularly well positioned to benefit from institutional adoption of prediction markets.
points: CANTOR · BULLISH ON ROBINHOOD + PREDICTION MARKETS
newsStories.takeaway: THE SAME INDUSTRY THAT ONCE CALLED CRYPTO A TOY IS NOW COMPETING TO OWN THE PIPES.
newsStories.source: Yahoo Finance / StreetInsider via Sep 15 digest

newsStories.headline: RWA WATCH · TOKENIZATION IS ESCAPING FINANCE
newsStories.dek: Energy, mortgages and national identity show how broad the onchain thesis is becoming.
newsStories.body: Today's alerts include Lake Energy launching a renewable-energy RWA platform, a reported $10 billion tokenized mortgage asset migration planned for Injective, Solana's tokenized-stock footprint passing 800,000 addresses, and Avalanche integrating with UAE PASS national digital identity infrastructure.
newsStories.takeaway: RWA IS STARTING TO MEAN A LOT MORE THAN TREASURY BILLS ON A BLOCKCHAIN.
newsStories.source: Yahoo Finance Singapore / TradingView / Yahoo Finance / AMBCrypto via Sep 15 digest

robinhoodStories.headline: ROBINHOOD CORNER · STOCK TOKENS ARE GETTING REAL OWNERSHIP FEATURES
robinhoodStories.dek: Robinhood plans share redemptions and voting rights after criticism of its tokenized-stock model.
robinhoodStories.body: Today's digest reports Robinhood plans to add share redemptions and voting rights to stock tokens. That directly addresses criticism that tokenized exposure lacks important rights associated with traditional share ownership. Coinbase is also moving toward voting rights, while the broader debate continues over what exactly a 'tokenized stock' represents.
robinhoodStories.takeaway: THIS IS THE IMPORTANT PART: TOKENIZED STOCKS ARE EVOLVING FROM PRICE EXPOSURE TOWARD ACTUAL OWNERSHIP-LIKE RIGHTS.
robinhoodStories.source: CoinDesk / Yahoo Finance / Fortune via Sep 15 digest

robinhoodStories.headline: THE AMC FIGHT JUST GOT MORE INTERESTING
robinhoodStories.dek: The argument isn't whether tokenization exists anymore. It's who controls it.
robinhoodStories.body: AMC leadership has attacked unauthorized tokenized versions of its stock while Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev has pushed back. SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce has also emphasized that tokenized stocks can represent very different legal and economic structures depending on how they're built.
robinhoodStories.takeaway: WE'VE MOVED FROM 'WILL STOCKS BE TOKENIZED?' TO 'WHO GETS TO TOKENIZE THEM AND WHAT RIGHTS COME WITH THE TOKEN?'
robinhoodStories.source: Fortune / Yahoo Finance via Sep 15 digest

aiStories.headline: AI DOOM METER · DOES AI NEED A KILL SWITCH?
aiStories.dek: Anthropic's co-founder says mandatory shutdown mechanisms may eventually be necessary.
aiStories.body: BBC coverage in today's digest says an Anthropic co-founder raised the possibility that AI models may need mandatory kill switches. MIT Technology Review separately reports research where AI agents identified cheating by other agents, while broader warnings about advanced AI risks continue to hit mainstream news.
points: AI SAFETY · NOW A POLICY QUESTION
DOOM METER · WHERE ARE WE TODAY?
aiStories.takeaway: IF WE'RE SERIOUSLY DISCUSSING A MANDATORY OFF SWITCH, THE AI CONVERSATION HAS CLEARLY LEFT THE CHATBOT ERA.
aiStories.source: BBC / MIT Technology Review / AP via Sep 15 digest

sportsStories.headline: NFL · WEEK 2 POWER RANKINGS ARE ALREADY CHAOTIC
sportsStories.body: The Athletic's Week 2 rankings highlighted the 49ers, Bears and Giants surging while the Rams and Chargers slid. Jaxson Dart drew attention against Dallas, while Kyler Murray suffered a concussion in his Vikings debut.
sportsStories.takeaway: ONE WEEK OF FOOTBALL AND EVERY PRESEASON TAKE IS ALREADY ON TRIAL.
sportsStories.source: New York Times / Yahoo Sports via Sep 15 digest

sportsStories.headline: NBA · KAWHI LEONARD IS GOING BACK TO TORONTO
sportsStories.body: NBA.com reports the Clippers and Raptors agreed to complete a Kawhi Leonard trade that sends him back to Toronto.
sportsStories.takeaway: KAWHI BACK TO TORONTO WAS NOT ON MY 2026 BINGO CARD.
sportsStories.source: NBA.com / CBS Sports via Sep 15 digest

sportsStories.headline: UFC / BOXING QUICK HITS
sportsStories.body: Tom Aspinall has vacated the UFC heavyweight championship after further eye damage. Retired UFC champion Henry Cejudo is also scheduled to make his professional boxing debut September 26, while Conor Benn is weighing his future after the Ryan Garcia loss.
sportsStories.takeaway: COMBAT SPORTS REFUSES TO HAVE A NORMAL WEEK.
sportsStories.source: Yahoo Sports / ESPN / Sky Sports / BBC via Sep 15 digest
